SATYAM KUMAR Senior ServiceNow Developer | HRSD | ITSM | Integrations | Automation Bengaluru, Karnataka | +91 62876 84500 | krsatyam471@gmail.com

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

ServiceNow Developer with 4 years of experience in designing, developing, and supporting enterprise solutions across HRSD and ITSM. Skilled in Flow Designer, REST/SOAP integrations, UI Builder, Agent Workspace, Service Portal, JavaScript, data migration, platform upgrades, and production support. Experienced in end-to-end delivery covering requirement analysis, development, testing, deployment, and post-production support. Built ServiceNow applications using Now Assist and the ServiceNow SDK with Fluent development. ServiceNow certified in CSA, CAD, HRSD, and ITSM.

CORE TECHNICAL SKILLS

ServiceNow Modules

HRSD, ITSM, Incident, Change, Problem, Service Catalog, Knowledge Management

Development

Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes, UI Policies, UI Actions, ACLs, Scheduled Jobs

Automation & UX

Flow Designer, UI Builder, Agent Workspace, Service Portal, Notifications, Inbound Email Actions

Integrations & Data

REST API, SOAP API, Import Sets, Transform Maps, data migration and validation

Tools & Delivery

JavaScript, ServiceNow SDK, Fluent APIs, VS Code, Node.js, Jira, Azure DevOps, Agile/Scrum, SIT, UAT

PROFESSIONAL EXPE RIENCE

EY India

Feb 2026 - Present

Senior Tech Consultant | Bengaluru, India

HRSD Implementation & Support • Configure and enhance HRSD capabilities, including HR Services, Centers of Excellence (COEs), HR case

processes, and lifecycle activities.

Develop UI Policies, UI Actions, related-list actions, scripts, form configurations, and Agent Workspace enhancements.

Build Flow Designer automation for SLA notifications and HR processes; configure email notifications and inbound email actions.

Create and maintain knowledge articles, reports, dashboards, SLAs, and supporting platform configurations. • Support ServiceNow platform upgrade activities, including impact analysis, unit testing, end-to-end testing, SIT, UAT, and defect resolution.

Work in Agile/Scrum delivery using Jira and contribute across requirement analysis, development, testing, deployment, and support.

Accenture Solutions Pvt. Ltd.

Aug 2022 - Feb 2026

ServiceNow Developer | Bengaluru, India

ITSM Development, Integrations & Platform Operations

Configured and enhanced core ServiceNow ITSM modules, including Incident, Change, Problem, Request, Service Catalog, and Knowledge Management, based on business and process requirements.

Developed and maintained Client Scripts, Business Rules, Script Includes, UI Policies, UI Actions, ACLs, and custom forms to implement scalable platform solutions and improve user experience.

Designed and implemented inbound and outbound REST/SOAP integrations for record creation, retrieval, updates, and synchronization with external enterprise systems.

Built and enhanced Service Catalog items, record fulfillment workflows, custom tables, fields, assignment rules, notifications, and approval configurations.

Developed Flow Designer automations to streamline ITSM processes, notifications, approvals, and service fulfillment activities.

Performed data migration and transformation using Import Sets, Transform Maps, and Scheduled Jobs, including data validation, reconciliation, and defect resolution.

Configured and customized Service Portal widgets and user-facing experiences to improve service request and self-service capabilities.

Supported ServiceNow platform upgrades and release activities, including impact analysis, testing, defect resolution, deployment validation, and post-release hypercare.

• Participated in requirement analysis and technical discussions with business and technical stakeholders to translate

Satyam Kumar | ServiceNow Developer

process requirements into ServiceNow configurations and development solutions.

• Supported SIT, UAT, deployment, production incidents, and post-production stabilization, ensuring changes were

delivered within agreed timelines and quality standards.

Troubleshot complex platform issues, performed root-cause analysis, and implemented permanent fixes to improve platform stability and reduce recurring incidents.

Worked in Agile/Scrum delivery using Jira and Azure DevOps, contributing to sprint planning, refinement, development, testing, deployment, and production support.

Contributed to custom ServiceNow application development using reusable scripting, modular configuration, and platform-native capabilities.

Collaborated with senior developers and architects on integration, application development, and platform enhancement initiatives, following ServiceNow development and configuration best practices.

Key Contributions

ITSM Platform Enhancement: Enhanced Incident, Change, Problem, Request, Service Catalog, and Knowledge Management capabilities.

Enterprise Integrations: Developed REST/SOAP integrations supporting bi-directional data exchange with external systems.

Automation: Implemented Flow Designer and workflow-based automation for service fulfillment and notifications. • Platform Operations: Supported deployments, upgrades, production incidents, data migration, and post-release hypercare.

Application Development: Developed custom tables, application components, business logic, and reusable ServiceNow configurations.

APPLICATION DEVELOPMENT & INNOVATION • Built a custom ServiceNow application using Now Assist to accelerate application configuration and development

activities.

Developed application components including custom tables, fields, forms, roles, business logic, and automated flows. • Built a ServiceNow application using the ServiceNow SDK and Fluent development approach with source-controlled project files.

Used CLI-based instance interaction to create, deploy, and maintain ServiceNow application artifacts. • Applied reusable scripting, modular design, and automation practices to improve maintainability and delivery consistency. • Prepared and delivered knowledge-sharing presentations on Now Assist, ServiceNow SDK, Fluent development, and modern application development practices.

SELECTED PROJECT EXPERIENCE HRSD Implementation & Enhancement

Configured HR Services, COEs, lifecycle activities, SLAs, notifications, knowledge content, Agent Workspace enhancements, and Flow Designer automation. Supported testing, defect resolution, deployment, and platform upgrade activities.

ITSM Development & Integrations

Configured core ITSM processes and request fulfilment capabilities. Built REST/SOAP integrations, migrated data using Import Sets and Transform Maps, and supported production operations within agreed SLAs.

Now Assist & ServiceNow SDK Application

Built scoped application components using Now Assist and the ServiceNow SDK, including source-controlled Fluent artifacts and CLI-based deployment. Demonstrated the development approach through internal presentations and showcases.

Satyam Kumar | ServiceNow Developer

AWARDS & RECOGNITION

Leadership Recognition - Google Project (Aug 2024): Recognized for contribution, ownership, and support provided to the project team.

Sparkling Star Award - Alstom Project (Dec 2023): Awarded for consistent performance and contribution to project delivery.

Project Recognition - Circle K (Nov 2022): Recognized for contribution and support during project delivery.

EDUCATION

Bachelor of Engineering in Information Technology Silicon Institute of Technology, Sambalpur (BPUT) | CGPA: 8.45/10

CERTIFICATIONS

SERVICENOW MICRO-CERTIFICATION

• Now Assist • • •

Flow Designer

Integrated Risk Management (IRM) IntegrationHub ServiceNow Fundamentals

Satyam Kumar | ServiceNow Developer
